name: FFS_LAYOUT_ITEM
description: Contains items added to particular layouts.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.description: PK.It is an ID of this layout item.

columns.name: LAYOUT_ID
columns.description: It is a reference to the layout this item belongs to.

columns.name: LAYOUT_GROUP
columns.description: Group of the layout item ('main', 'actions', 'buttons').

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Type of the layout item ('main', 'action', 'button', 'field','bo_field','property', 'menu_item', 'tab', 'text').

columns.name: PARENT
columns.description: It is a reference to a parent 'section' or 'tab' item ('main' group only).

columns.name: SORTING_ORDER
columns.description: It is an item sorting order inside of the same group.

columns.name: ENTITY
columns.description: It is a type of the entity this object belongs to.

columns.name: FIELD
columns.description: It is the name of the field to be shown (if type = 'field' or 'marker').

columns.name: PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: It is a reference to property (if type = 'field' or 'property').

columns.name: ACTION_LINK_ID
columns.description: It is a reference to action link (if type = 'action').

columns.name: PRIVILEGE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: It is a reference to security module (if type = 'menu_item').

columns.name: DEFAULT_VISIBILITY
columns.description: It is a default visibility of this item.

columns.name: FONT_STYLE
columns.description: Font feight for an item in GUI, mask : 0 - BOLD, 1 - ITALIC.

columns.name: FONT_SIZE
columns.description: Font size for an item in GUI: 1 - Small, 2 - Big.

columns.name: TEXT_COLOR
columns.description: Font hex color for an Item In gui. Value without # symbol. Example: 170FFF.

columns.name: FORM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the form. Form Id.

columns.name: IS_SCANNER
columns.description: Is this element allow scanning. 0 or null -> not allow, 1 -> allow.

columns.name: MIN_NUM_IMAGES
columns.description: Min number of images for multi-image property for an item in GUI.

columns.name: MAX_NUM_IMAGES
columns.description: Max number of images for multi-image property for an item in GUI.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).

columns.name: PARAMETERS
